description:
This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'smarty_modifiercompiler_wordwrap' which compiles a PHP code snippet to perform a word wrap operation within Smarty templates. Its purpose is to generate code that wraps a given string to a specified length, with optional customization.

It includes logic to fall back to Unicode-aware word wrapping if available, and defines default parameters for wrap length, line break string, and cut words flag.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase
classes.description: Base class for Smarty template compiler, used here to retrieve plugins.

classes.name: Smarty
classes.description: Main Smarty class, with static property '_MBSTRING' indicating if multibyte string functions are supported.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_wordwrap
methods.description: Compiles a Smarty wordwrap modifier into PHP code, choosing between 'wordwrap' and 'mb_wordwrap' depending on multibyte string support.
